sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: MODELS INDICATE THAT AN AMPLIFIED UPPER FLOW REGIME WILL PERSIST THROUGH THIS PERIOD...WITH AN UPPER TROUGH LINGERING FROM THE MISSISSIPPI VALLEY INTO THE APPALACHIANS...BETWEEN RIDGING OVER THE INTERMOUNTAIN WEST/ROCKIES AND HIGH PLAINS AND RIDGING OVER THE WESTERN ATLANTIC. WHILE ONLY A SLIGHT EASTWARD SHIFT OF THE UPPER TROUGH IS EXPECTED...ONE EMBEDDED CLOSED LOW IS PROGGED TO LIFT NORTHEASTWARD OUT OF THE UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION...AS ANOTHER BEGINS TO FORM JUST TO THE SOUTH OF THE GREAT LAKES...IN RESPONSE TO ANOTHER DIGGING JET STREAK UPSTREAM OF THE TROUGH AXIS. FORCING WITH THIS LATTER DEVELOPMENT MAY CONTRIBUTE TO WIDELY SCATTERED AFTERNOON THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS PARTS OF THE MIDWEST. BUT...CONVECTIVE POTENTIAL IS EXPECTED TO BE HIGHEST ACROSS THE ATLANTIC SEABOARD AND GULF COAST STATES...WHERE MOISTURE CONTENT WILL REMAIN HIGH IN ADVANCE OF THE LEADING EDGE OF A SERIES OF COOL/DRY INTRUSIONS ACCOMPANYING THE UPPER TROUGH. ACROSS THE WEST...MOISTENING...ASSOCIATED WITH IMPULSES WITHIN A BELT OF EASTERLIES ACROSS PARTS OF THE SOUTHERN PLATEAU...AND AHEAD OF A SHORT WAVE TROUGH MIGRATING INLAND ACROSS THE PACIFIC NORTHWEST...IS EXPECTED TO CONTRIBUTE TO DESTABILIZATION TODAY.

sections.title: NORTHEASTERN U.S
sections.text: LIMITED SURFACE HEATING DUE TO CONSIDERABLE CLOUD COVER...AND THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES CHARACTERIZED BY A HIGH DEGREE OF SATURATION AND WEAK MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...ARE POTENTIAL LIMITING FACTORS TO SEVERE POTENTIAL TODAY. HOWEVER...AS SOUTHWESTERLY MID/UPPER FLOW STRENGTHENS EAST OF THE DEPARTING GREAT LAKES CYCLONE /40-50+ KT AT 500 MB/...FROM THE LEE OF THE LOWER GREAT LAKES THROUGH NEW ENGLAND...DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS EXPECTED TO BECOME STRONG IN THE PRESENCE OF AT LEAST MODEST CONDITIONAL INSTABILITY. THIS WILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT... WITH AT LEAST MODEST STORM MOTIONS/DOWNWARD MOMENTUM TRANSFER...AND HEAVY PRECIPITATION LOADING...CONTRIBUTING TO POTENTIALLY DAMAGING SURFACE GUSTS. DISCRETE SUPERCELLS ARE ALSO A DISTINCT POSSIBILITY...AND WHILE LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS MAY NOT BECOME PARTICULARLY LARGE...A BOUNDARY LAYER AIR MASS CHARACTERIZED BY HIGH HUMIDITY AND DEW POINTS NEAR 70F MAY BE SUPPORTIVE OF ISOLATED TORNADOES. THIS ACTIVITY APPEARS MOST LIKELY FROM PARTS OF EASTERN NEW YORK AND PENNSYLVANIA INTO WESTERN/SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND...BUT IS POSSIBLE AS FAR SOUTH AS AREAS TO THE LEE OF THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. ..KERR/SM

sections.title: NORTHEAST STATES
sections.text: A LARGE UPPER TROUGH WILL CONTINUE TO ROTATE EASTWARD ACROSS THE GREAT LAKES AND OHIO VALLEY TODAY...WITH THE MAIN SURFACE COLD FRONT MOVING ACROSS THE APPALACHIANS INTO THE NORTHEAST STATES. AHEAD OF THE FRONT...VERY MOIST AIR IS IN PLACE WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE 70S AND MORNING RAOBS SHOWING PW VALUES WELL ABOVE 2 INCHES. EARLY VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SUGGESTS THAT WIDESPREAD CLOUDS WILL LIMIT HEATING AND DESTABILIZATION IN MOST AREAS. HOWEVER...SUFFICIENTLY STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL RESULT IN MODERATE AFTERNOON INSTABILITY AND POSE A RISK OF SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS OVER A LARGE AREA OF NEW ENGLAND/NY/PA AND ADJACENT REGIONS. SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING THIS MORNING AHEAD OF THE FRONT FROM NY INTO EASTERN KY. THIS ACTIVITY WILL PROGRESS EASTWARD THROUGH THE DAY AND WILL LIKELY INTENSIFY...POSING A RISK OF ISOLATED SEVERE WEATHER BY EARLY AFTERNOON FROM EASTERN NY/PA INTO WESTERN NEW ENGLAND. OTHER BANDS OF STRONG CONVECTION ARE LIKELY TO DEVELOP THROUGH THE AFTERNOON IN REGIONS WHERE HEATING CAN OCCUR. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW SUFFICIENT EFFECTIVE SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED UPDRAFTS AND SUPERCELLS...ALONG WITH BOW/LEWP STRUCTURES IN LARGER CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS. DAMAGING WI

sections.title: ELSEWHERE
sections.text: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED AHEAD OF THE TRAILING BOUNDARY ACROSS THE TN VALLEY AND GULF COAST STATES. A FEW OF THESE STORMS MAY PRODUCE LOCALLY GUSTY/DAMAGING WINDS...BUT ORGANIZED SEVERE WEATHER IS NOT ANTICIPATED. A FEW STRONG STORMS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE THIS EVENING OVER SOUTHERN AZ AS EASTERLY MID LEVEL WINDS INCREASE THE THREAT OF THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY AFFECTING THE LOWER DESERTS. ..HART/GRAMS.. 08/21/2009

sections.title: NORTHEAST STATES
sections.text: LARGE UPPER LOW/TROUGH OVER THE GREAT LAKES/OH VALLEY REGION WILL ROTATE NEWD ACROSS THE NERN STATES THIS AFTERNOON....WITH STRONG SHORTWAVE TROUGH/SPEED MAX SHIFTING NEWD THROUGH WRN PA/NY INTO THE EVENING HOURS. STORMS HAVE ALREADY DEVELOPED AHEAD OF THE UPPER TROUGH ACROSS PORTIONS OF ERN PA/SRN NY...REFERENCE WW/S 726 AND 727...AND AS FORCING SPREADS ACROSS THE REGION...WIDESPREAD STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE ANTICIPATED. THE VERY MOIST AIR MASS IN PLACE...DEWPOINTS 68 TO 75...COMBINED WITH PW VALUES AROUND 2 INCHES AND ADDITIONAL HEATING SHOULD RESULT IN MLCAPES TO RANGE FROM 3000 J/KG IN AREAS THAT RECEIVE STRONG WARMING...TO 1500 J/KG WHERE CLOUDS ARE MORE PERSISTENT. A 50-60 KT MID LEVEL SPEED MAX WILL RESULT IN SUFFICIENT SHEAR FOR SUPERCELLS AND LINE SEGMENTS/BOW ECHOES THROUGHOUT THE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING HOURS. UNIDIRECTIONAL SWLY WINDS THAT INCREASE WITH HEIGHT ABOVE THE BOUNDARY LAYER WILL BE MOSTLY FAVORABLE FOR DAMAGING WINDS. HOWEVER...THE PRESENCE OF A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER AND VEERING WINDS WITHIN THE BOUNDARY LAYER MAY SUPPORT A TORNADO OR TWO.

sections.title: CENTRAL/ERN TX ENEWD INTO THE CAROLINAS
sections.text: STRONG TO OCCASIONALLY SEVERE ELEVATED STORMS WERE ONGOING ACROSS PORTIONS OF NRN TX THIS MORNING WITHIN AREA OF MODERATE INSTABILITY AND EFFECTIVE SHEAR AROUND 30 KT. THESE STORMS SHOULD DIMINISH AS WEAK MID LEVEL WARM ADVECTION SUBSIDES. HOWEVER...DESPITE WEAK DYNAMICAL FORCING...CONVERGENCE ALONG OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES/EDGE OF THICKER CLOUDS AND WHERE STRONGER HEATING/DESTABILIZATION OCCURS...WILL FAVOR SCATTERED STRONG STORMS DURING THE AFTERNOON/EVENING HOURS. SINCE THE SHEAR WILL NOT BE PARTICULARLY STRONG AND THE THREAT FOR SEVERE STORMS APPEARS LOCALIZED...ONLY LOW SEVERE PROBABILITIES ARE FORECAST.

sections.title: NRN CONTINENTAL DIVIDE AREA
sections.text: SOUTHERN TAIL OF UPPER TROUGH IN BC WILL MOVE EWD ACROSS THE NRN ROCKIES LATER TODAY. CONVECTION HAS OCCURRED IN FAR NWRN MT THIS MORNING IN ASSOCIATION WITH A SHORTWAVE TROUGH LIFTING NEWD INTO ALBERTA. MORE STORMS SHOULD DEVELOP LATER TODAY AS LARGE SCALE FORCING SPREADS IN FROM THE WEST. DEEP LAYER SHEAR AT 30 TO 40 KT...MUCAPES NEAR 2000 J/KG AND STEEP LOW-MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES SHOULD SUPPORT A FEW STORMS WITH STRONG AND GUSTY WINDS. ..IMY/GARNER.. 08/21/2009

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS SOUTHERN AZ
sections.text: AMENDED FOR SEVERE RISKS IN MAINE/WW 730 AND AZ

sections.title: NORTHEAST STATES/NEW ENGLAND AND DELMARVA
sections.text: A NUMBER OF SEVERE TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP/SPREAD EAST-NORTHEASTWARD INTO THE EVENING HOURS ACROSS WESTERN/SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND AND NJ/NYC VICINITY AND DELMARVA WITHIN LOW LEVEL INSTABILITY/CONFLUENCE AXIS. WITH A VERY MOIST AIRMASS IN PLACE...AND AMPLE HEATING CONTRIBUTING TO MODERATE INSTABILITY ESPECIALLY NJ TO SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND...SCENARIO IS SUPPORTED ON THE LARGE SCALE BY A LEAD SHORTWAVE TROUGH/SPEED MAXIMA PIVOTING NORTHEASTWARD OVER THE LOWER GREAT LAKES/NY VICINITY. A FEW QUASI-DISCRETE/LINE-EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS WITH BRIEF TORNADO POTENTIAL WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS MAINLY ACROSS SOUTHERN/WESTERN NEW ENGLAND...BUT LARGELY UNIDIRECTIONAL LOW/MID TROPOSPHERIC WINDS /PER 18Z OBSERVED RAOBS AND WSR-88D VWPS/ SHOULD MAINTAIN A DECIDEDLY LINEAR CONVECTIVE MODE WITH SMALL BOWS AND DAMAGING WINDS AS THE PRIMARY HAZARD.

sections.title: AZ
sections.text: HAVE INTRODUCED A SLIGHT RISK FOR PORTIONS OF SOUTHERN AZ. FOR ADDITIONAL DETAILS...SEE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1949. AS AN INCREASINGLY MOIST AIRMASS CONTINUES TO DEVELOP INTO AZ PER GPS DERIVED PW DATA AND 12Z/18Z OBSERVED RAOBS...AMPLE HEATING OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN SHOULD RESULT IN INCREASING TSTMS THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING ACROSS SOUTHEAST AZ. PER THE 18Z TUCSON OBSERVED RAOB...MODESTLY STRONG EAST-SOUTHEASTERLY STEERING FLOW BETWEEN 2-6 KM SHOULD ALLOW SOME STORMS TO PROPAGATE ONTO THE SOUTHERN AZ DESERT FLOOR...WITH A FEW MICROBURSTS POSSIBLE.

sections.title: ELSEWHERE
sections.text: EARLIER FORECAST/REASONING GENERALLY HOLDS...WITH MAINLY ISOLATED SEVERE TSTMS POSSIBLE ACROSS PORTIONS OF TX TO THE SOUTHEAST STATES/FL...AND PERHAPS PORTIONS OF WESTERN MT AS WELL. ..GUYER.. 08/21/2009 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1108 AM CDT FRI AUG 21 2009/
